purpose: Estimate calibrated unordered TRIO hit probabilities directly from frozen L1.75 horse context. L2 does probability estimation only; ticket selection, expected-value thresholds, bankroll allocation, and stakes belong to L3.

probability_model.learner: LightGBM binary scoring model followed by race-normalized softmax and strict-prior temperature calibration
probability_model.reason: TRIO is an unordered one-of-N race event in ordinary non-dead-heat races. Direct combination scoring avoids forcing TRIO probability to be only a by-product of a WIN-strength model.
probability_model.dead_heat_policy: Races with zero or more than one official winning TRIO combination are excluded from V2 training and primary probability metrics and reported separately.
probability_model.historical_win_odds: Final WIN odds are allowed only as the historical L1.75 market-context proxy. Operational inference must use the latest timestamped pre-race WIN snapshot.

forbidden_probability_features: post-race result fields except the training label

baselines: PL-style TRIO from normalized inverse WIN market odds
evaluation.promotion_rule: No promotion from ROI. Improvement must be visible in probability calibration and walk-forward stability.
